# tanstack-fetch v2.0.0

> Typed Fetch client designed for TanStack Query. Return data, throw `FetchError`, honor `AbortSignal`. TanStack Start, React, Remix, Vue/Nuxt, Solid, SolidStart, Angular, Svelte/SvelteKit. SSR, SSE, WebSocket, WebTransport, NDJSON streams, upload, tRPC, DevTools.

Docs: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/docs/
Repo: https://github.com/mohamadgarmabi/tanstack-fetch
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tanstack-fetch
Changelog: https://github.com/mohamadgarmabi/tanstack-fetch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Sitemap: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/sitemap-pages.xml
Sitemap: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/robots.txt

Not an official TanStack package.

## Version

**2.0.0** — breaking: slim core `tanstack-fetch` (3.57KB gzip) takes auth / status handlers / plugins as `interceptors` from `tanstack-fetch/plugins` (`createAuthInterceptor`, `createStatusInterceptor`, `createTraceInterceptor`, …); option shortcuts (`getToken`, `onUnauthorized`, `plugins: [...]`), `upload()` and progress stay on `/sse`, `/live`, `/trpc` and framework providers. Typed live params: `sse` / `ws` / `transport` / `stream` and `useSse` / `useWs` type `params` like `api.get` — `ws<Message, Params, Send>`, `sse<Message, Params>`. NDJSON: `duplex: 'half'` for stream bodies, `onRequestError` on network errors, abortable retry delays (/blog/tanstack-fetch-2-0-0).

**1.8.0** — new `tanstack-fetch/live` entry: `api.ws()` (WebSocket: `Authorization` header on Node 22+/Bun/Deno, explicit `authIn: 'query' | 'protocol'` in browsers — never leaks a token by default; auto-reconnect with fresh token, send queue, interceptors), `api.transport()` (same API over WebTransport / HTTP/3 datagrams), `api.stream()` (NDJSON over fetch, any method + body, full interceptor pipeline, works with TanStack Query `streamedQuery`), `useWs` in react/vue/solid/svelte/angular (/guide/websocket, /blog/tanstack-fetch-1-8-0).

**1.7.1** — fixes: ports / query colons no longer parsed as path params; `timeoutMs` rejects with `TimeoutError` (`isAbortError` true, not `NETWORK_ERROR`, skips `onRequestError`); timeout timers cleared; typed-array / `ReadableStream` bodies sent as-is; non-2xx with non-JSON body keeps status (`HTTP_ERROR`, raw text in `body`) and runs `onResponseError`; `PARSE_ERROR` only for 2xx (/blog/tanstack-fetch-1-7-1).

**1.7.0** — `tanstack-fetch/solid|svelte|angular`, `npx tanstack-fetch doctor`, migrate `--framework solid|angular|svelte|sveltekit`, docs Framework picker (/blog/tanstack-fetch-1-7-0).

**1.6.3** — `npx tanstack-fetch migrate --from axios|ky|ofetch|fetch|all` (broader call sites + safer scan; /blog/tanstack-fetch-1-6-3, guide /guide/migrate).

**1.6.1** — path-typed `params` (`:id` / `{id}`), `api.get<User, { id: number }>(…)`, optional body typing on `post` / `put` / `patch` (`NoParams` to skip params).

## Install

```bash
npm install tanstack-fetch @tanstack/react-query
# Vue / Nuxt
npm install tanstack-fetch vue
```

## Agent skill (Cursor / Claude / Codex)

```bash
npx skills add mohamadgarmabi/tanstack-fetch --skill tanstack-fetch
# or: pnpm dlx / yarn dlx / bunx skills add …
```

Skill page: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/guide/skill  
Raw skill: https://mohamadgarmabi.github.io/tanstack-fetch/skills/tanstack-fetch/SKILL.md

## Mental model

1. Return data on success
2. Throw `FetchError` on HTTP failure (default)
3. Honor `AbortSignal` — pass Query’s `signal`
4. Never wrap as `{ data }` like axios
5. Prefer one shared `api` module

## Quickstart

```ts
import { createFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'

const api = createFetch({ baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com' })

useQuery({
  queryKey: ['users'],
  queryFn: ({ signal }) => api.get<User[]>('/users', { signal }),
})
```

## Entry points (gzip, minified ESM)

| Import | Role | gzip |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| `tanstack-fetch` | Slim HTTP; auth / status / plugins via `interceptors` | 3.57KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/sse` | Full HTTP (option shortcuts, `upload`) + `api.sse()` | 6.33KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/plugins` | interceptor factories | 1.13KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/react` | `FetchProvider` / `useFetch` / `useSse` | 0.99KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/vue` | `createFetchPlugin` / `useFetch` / `useSse` | 0.78KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/solid` | `FetchProvider` / `useFetch` / `useSse` | — |
| `tanstack-fetch/svelte` | `setFetchClient` / `useFetch` / `useSse` | — |
| `tanstack-fetch/angular` | `provideFetchClient` / `injectFetch` / `useSse` | — |
| `tanstack-fetch/trpc` | tRPC link via `createFetch` | 3.16KB |
| `tanstack-fetch/devtools` | `setupDevtools(api)` | 8.69KB |

```ts
import { createFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch' // HTTP only
import { createFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch/sse' // + streams
```

## Important: `useFetch` does not fetch

In React and Vue, `useFetch()` **injects the shared client** from context/plugin. It returns `api` — it does not perform an HTTP request.

Nuxt already has a core `useFetch`. Alias ours:

```ts
import { useFetch as useFetchClient } from 'tanstack-fetch/vue'
```

## Vue / Nuxt

```ts
import { createFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch/sse'
import { createFetchPlugin, useSse, useFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch/vue'

const api = createFetch({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL,
  plugins: ['sse-resume'],
  getToken: () => localStorage.getItem('access_token'),
})

// Vue
createApp(App).use(createFetchPlugin({ client: api })).mount('#app')
const client = useFetch()

// Nuxt plugin
export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => {
  nuxtApp.vueApp.use(createFetchPlugin({ client: api }))
  return { provide: { api } }
})

// SSE — plugin optional when passing client
const { data, status, error, close } = useSse<OrderEvent>('/orders/stream', {
  client: api,
})
// status: 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error'
```

`provideFetchClient(api)` must run in a **parent** setup for child inject. Prefer `createFetchPlugin` app-wide.

## React

```ts
import { FetchProvider, useFetch, useSse } from 'tanstack-fetch/react'
import { createFetch } from 'tanstack-fetch/sse'

const api = createFetch({ plugins: ['sse-resume'] })
// <FetchProvider client={api}>…</FetchProvider>
const { data, status, close } = useSse('/orders/stream', { client: api })
```

## Path params

```ts
await api.get('/users/:id', { params: { id } })
await api.get<User, { id: number }>('/users/:id', { params: { id } })
await api.post<User, NoParams, { name: string }>('/users', { body: { name: 'Ada' } })
await api.get<User[]>('/users', { query: { page: 1 } })
```

## Errors

```ts
import { isFetchError } from 'tanstack-fetch'

try {
  await api.get('/missing')
} catch (error) {
  if (isFetchError(error)) {
    // error.status, error.code, error.body, error.message
  }
}
```

## Status handlers

Shortcuts on `createFetch` from `tanstack-fetch/sse` / `/live` / providers: `getToken`, `onUnauthorized` (401), `onForbidden` (403), `onNotFound` (404), `onTooManyRequests` (429), `onClientError`, `onServerError`, plus `onStatus` map. On the slim core (`tanstack-fetch`) use `interceptors: [createAuthInterceptor({ getToken }), createStatusInterceptor({ 401: fn, '5xx': fn })]` from `tanstack-fetch/plugins`. Use `parseRetryAfter` for 429.

## Refresh token

```ts
import { createRefreshTokenInterceptor } from 'tanstack-fetch/plugins'

api.use(
  'refresh-token',
  createRefreshTokenInterceptor({
    refresh: async () => {
      const body = await api.post<{ accessToken: string }>('/auth/refresh', {
        interceptors: { eject: ['refresh-token', 'auth'] },
      })
      /* persist body.accessToken */
    },
    before: { getExpiresAt: () => expiresAt, skewMs: 60_000 },
    after: { enabled: true },
  }),
)
```

- **before** — refresh near expiry
- **after** — on first 401, single-flight, then `{ action: 'retry' }`

## DevTools

```ts
import { setupDevtools } from 'tanstack-fetch/devtools'

setupDevtools(api) // Alt+Shift+F / ⌥⇧F
// options: { http, sse, ssr, trpc, open }
```

## SSR

`createSsrForwardInterceptor()` (core) or `plugins: ['ssr-forward']` (`/sse`) + `incoming` cookies/headers. Absolute `baseUrl` on the server. Guides: Next.js and Nuxt.

## Upload

Needs `createFetch` from `tanstack-fetch/sse` (core has no `upload()` / progress).

```ts
await api.upload('/files', {
  body: { file },
  onUploadProgress: ({ progress }) => console.log(progress),
})

await api.get('/files/report.pdf', {
  parseAs: 'blob',
  onDownloadProgress: ({ progress, loaded, total }) => console.log(progress, loaded, total),
})
```

## tRPC

```ts
import { createTRPCFetchClient } from 'tanstack-fetch/trpc'

const trpcClient = createTRPCFetchClient<AppRouter>({ url: '/api/trpc', client: api })
```

## Do / don’t

| Do | Don’t |
| --- | --- |
| One shared `api` | `createFetch()` per call site |
| Pass `{ signal }` from Query | Ignore abort |
| `isFetchError` for branches | Swallow errors |
| `tanstack-fetch/sse` for auth streams | `EventSource` when you need Bearer |
| `params` for `:id` paths | String-concat URLs |
| Alias Vue `useFetch` in Nuxt | Clash with Nuxt core `useFetch` |
| Treat `useFetch()` as client inject | Assume it performs HTTP |
